verdict.rationale: Rippling's benefits docs directly cover the story: employees can compare plans and enroll via AI-assisted flows, admins can approve dependents/EOI, reopen enrollments, and offer integrated HSA/FSA/commuter benefits, with deductions explicitly stated to always sync with payroll (docs-24), and EOI approvals bulk-adjusting payroll deductions (docs-23,41). HR data including benefits deductions flows automatically into Payroll (docs-13), confirming the enrollment-to-payroll sync loop. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the payroll-sync accuracy and no community corroboration specific to benefits administration (only vendor docs).
